title: Training & Research Coordinator - Cybersecurity
description:
**What should we launch next - and who can deliver it?**

**🎯 Training Research + Cybersecurity + Trainer Sourcing**

﻿

If you enjoy researching emerging technologies, comparing training programs, finding industry experts and discovering what professionals want to learn next, this role could be a great fit.

This is a good opportunity for someone who enjoys research, networking, technology and turning information into actionable recommendations.

**Company:**
InfosecTrain -
*www.infosectrain.com*

**📍 Thiruvananthapuram | Onsite**

**💼 0–3 years | ₹2–3 LPA**

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Training & Research Coordinator who is curious about technology, enjoys research and has an interest in the cybersecurity and professional training ecosystem.

**What You Will Do**

**Training & Market Research**

* Research emerging technologies, cybersecurity domains, certifications and industry trends.
* **Identify new course, workshop and bootcamp opportunities based on market demand.**
* Research competitor training programs, certifications, pricing, formats and offerings.
* Identify gaps and opportunities in our existing training portfolio.
* Track
  **new certifications and technologies**
  relevant to the IT and cybersecurity market.

**Trainer & Resource Research**

* Research and identify suitable
  **trainers, instructors and cybersecurity professionals.**
* Build and maintain a database of relevant industry experts and trainers.
* Evaluate trainer profiles based on technical expertise, certifications, industry experience and training capability.
* **Reach out**
  to potential trainers and coordinate with them regarding training opportunities.
* Share suitable trainer/resource profiles with the Training & Academics team.

**Reporting & Coordination**

* Prepare simple and actionable market research reports and recommendations.
* Present findings on new technologies, certifications, competitors and potential training programs.
* Maintain updated research databases, trainer information and course/market trackers.
* Coordinate with internal teams to support new course and program development.

**What We're Looking For**

Must Have

* **0–3 years of experience in research, training coordination, L&D, technical recruitment, resource sourcing, market research or a related area.**
* Strong internet research and information-gathering skills.
* Good written and verbal communication.
* Ability to communicate professionally with trainers and industry professionals.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets and presentation tools.
* Strong curiosity about technology and willingness to learn the cybersecurity ecosystem.
* Ability to work independently, organise information and meet deadlines.
* Good to Have
* Knowledge of cybersecurity, IT, cloud, data privacy, GRC, networking or related technology areas.
* Experience in training/L&D coordination.
* Experience in technical recruitment or trainer/resource sourcing.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, ISO 27001, CEH, CompTIA Security+ or similar is an add-on.
* **Experience with competitor research or market research.**

**Freshers**
are welcome if they have relevant internships, academic projects, certifications or demonstrated interest/knowledge in IT or cybersecurity.

Candidates currently based in
**Thiruvananthapuram or nearby locations will be preferred.**
Candidates willing to relocate to Thiruvananthapuram may also apply.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn Easy Apply or share their updated resume at:

**📧 hr@infosectrain.com**

**📱 8882179274**

* Please mention your current location, total experience, current CTC, expected CTC and notice period while applying.
